scope: Independent static technical/visual/factual/specification/runtime_parse review for the four exact frozen candidates only. No producer edits, commits, uploads, releases, GPU/composed-scene or website tests.

verification_methods.official_gltf_validator: Khronos glTF Validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10 fresh parse, exact shipped GLB hash
verification_methods.node_loader: Three.js 0.180 GLTFLoader.parseAsync, fresh parse of exact shipped GLB hash
verification_methods.saved_source_reopen: Blender 4.3.2; read-only open with autoexec disabled, export only frozen EXPORT collection using original flags; reexport exact-byte matched shipped GLB for each
verification_methods.reproducibility: Examined and independently re-validated two distinct already-executed producer semantic rebuild records per candidate, checking PID/time/request/result/output and output hash; did not treat shared batch run_id as a cached replay
verification_methods.visual: Inspected each genuine original concept, all 32 individual 512x512 final frames and all four full contact sheets against original frozen briefs/configs and actual selected primary-reference pixels

independent_rebuild_pair.note: The batch run_id label is shared, but PIDs, times, request/result identities, fingerprints, paths and output files are distinct; both distinct outputs hash to the selected final GLB.

assessment.rangea: Six-radial bilaminar spindle reading is present as a compact tapered 3D fossil-form, not a living whole. Oblique primary rib/facet relief is physically present and visible in the close inspection, but fine subordinate branching remains subdued at 512 px. Accepted static with this material readability limitation explicitly retained; the reference and brief do not support claiming a scan or precise living anatomy.
assessment.serac: Dominant angular central tower, two deep intersecting crevasse cuts, unequal shoulders and continuous base tile are readable. Grid-like block faceting is stylization, but the tower/crevasses distinguish it from a generic pile of blocks.
assessment.moulin-shaft: Open upper-truncated shaft with visible inner ice wall, asymmetric rim and surface meltwater entry is readable in hero/top. Do not infer a fully modeled or closed lower-depth shaft. The 22 + 6 water-ribbon boundary edges are intentional openings, not a mesh-closure defect.
assessment.solifluction-lobe: Shallow tongue/toe on a sloped mantle with a connected neck is visible in hero/top and modest side/clay relief; it reads as a low-relief toe rather than a landslide. No exact site or active simulation is implied.

known_boundary_conditions: No GPU rendering, device timing, populated-scene, website/user/formal-review or publication tests were performed.
Khronos/Three.js/CPU source-export results are not substitutes for GPU, scene or release stages.

All four concept evidence records are valid but evidence_complete=false because provider internal timestamp metadata is unavailable. Unknown time is recorded as an evidence gap, not a blanket static rejection.

Rangea Monash 2013 PDF and UCL native endpoint were inaccessible (403); no claim of inspecting their pixels or CT data is made. Actual Rangea primary pixels inspected were Essex et al. 2018 Fig. 1 panels B/D/J; indexed primary text was read.
Moulin has 28 intentional open boundary edges in water ribbons (22 surface inlet + 6 inner-wall descent) recorded as warnings; no closed/deep/full-shaft requirement inferred.
Numerical intersection checks are not universal zero-intersection/GPU/composed-scene standards; existing producer diagnostic limits/failures remain unchanged.
Reference images and documents are third-party consult-only files outside the QA output directory and were not copied into the candidate or QA output.
raw_manifest_policy: RAW-MANIFEST enumerates only QA-owned output files and separates read-only producer inputs and external consult-only references; it does not copy or treat them as QA outputs.
